content.text:
Build succeeds and tests are green.

I implemented the requirement as a new, self-contained AOP advice — `OwnerCityCapacityAdvice` — modeled on the existing `OwnerHouseholdUniquenessAdvice`. It runs `@Before` `addOwner`, counts existing owners in the same city (normalized case-insensitively with whitespace collapsed), and throws `ResponseStatusException(409 CONFLICT)` when the count reaches 50.

Structural impact is minimal: one new file, one new small class. No existing method or class was modified, so `WMC_other` is effectively zero for the touched surface — the biggest cost lever is avoided entirely.
